features: 【Optimize Your Pro-Res Setup】Mount your Samsung T7 SSD (1/2/4TB) magnetically on your phone for a clean, stable recording setup - no dangling drives, no DIY hacks.
PRECISE FIT Specially molded to hold T7 drives with a snug fit. TPU case with rigid front plate absorbs shock from accidental drops.
Universal compatibility: compatible with MagSafe mobile phones/cases plus included self-adhesive magnetic ring for universal use.
【High Speed Data Transfer Cable】Includes 3" USB-C to USB-C 10Gbps cable - short enough to avoid sagging, fast enough for ProRes recording in real time without delay.
Purpose-built for mobile shooters: A streamlined solution for shooting with high bit rate, designed to stay out of the way and perform under pressure.
description: Magnetic Case for Samsung T7 Portable SSD This case is designed for creators who record ProRes or other high-bandwidth formats directly to external storage. Magnetically mount your SSD drive to your phone for streamlined setup while protecting the drive and maintaining a compact profile. With the included ultra-short 10Gbps cable, data transfer remains stable and fast - essential if you push the limits of mobile capture. Product specifications: Compatibility: Samsung T7 SSD (1TB, 2TB, 4TB) Mount: MagSafe compatible with MagSafe + adhesive ring included Materials: TPU body, PC faceplate Cable: 3" USB-C to USB-C 10Gbps Compatible with ProRes recordings and other high bit rate recording formats
